channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jerian Grant | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jerian Grant from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: once more on Victor Oladipo, Jerian Grant
item.description:
More on convo between @Orlando Magic G Jerian Grant & Victor Oladipo:

“(VO) was telling me about the organization, how much he loved it here & how they gave him the opportunity to become the player he’s become. I’m looking forward to growing with this organization like he did.”

once more on Victor Oladipo, Jerian Grant, Jul 9, 2018. Source: Twitter @JohnDenton555.

item.title: Dywane Wade on Jerian Grant
item.description:
KC Johnson:Wade:

“It’s tough because guys don’t know how many minutes they’re going to play. Jerian played 2 minutes and came out.”

Dywane Wade on Jerian Grant, Mar 11, 2017. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Jeff Hornacek on Jose Manuel Calderon, Jerian Grant
item.description:
Jeff Hornacek again sounded like a man who wouldn't mind if the Knicks acquired a point guard in free agency.

“The point guards we have, Jerian (Grant) is just a young player who is learning his way. He's going to get better and better as the years go on with the experience. And Jose (Calderon) is on the later side of it. So if we can find a point guard who, that's the 27, 28-year-old guy who has the experience and still has a lot of juice left, sure that would make us better. And the more shooters you can get, the better also,”

Jeff Hornacek on Jose Manuel Calderon, Jerian Grant, Jun 7, 2016. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Jerian Grant, Kristaps Porzingis
item.description:
Michael Scotto:Mark Cuban on Kristaps Porzingis:

“We would've traded up in a heartbeat to get that kid. We loved him and (Jerian) Grant too.”

Mark Cuban on Jerian Grant, Kristaps Porzingis, Dec 7, 2015. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Phil Jackson on Jerian Grant
item.description:
Ian Begley:Phil Jackson on Jerian Grant trade:

“We thought Timmy’s got a good chance to be an NBA pro, but (Grant's) more in tune with how we want to play.”

Phil Jackson on Jerian Grant, Sep 26, 2015. Source: Twitter @IanBegley.
